run_funsearch_experiment: run a FunSearch experiment by calling main with a specification string, test inputs, and a config object
extract_function_names: extract the evolve and run function names from a specification string using _extract_function_names
create_programs_database: create a ProgramsDatabase instance from a config, template program, and function name to evolve
create_evaluator: create an Evaluator instance with a database, template, evolve function, run function, and test inputs
create_sampler: create a Sampler instance with a database, evaluators list, and samples per prompt count
